_comment: The documents to compare. Copy to documents.json and edit.
documents.json is gitignored: it names real works, and this tool measures
textual overlap, which is a measurement and not an accusation.
Exactly one document must have role 'focal-earlier' and one 'focal-later'.
Every other document is a control, and the controls are the point: a raw
similarity score between two documents in the same field means very little
on its own. Use at least two, in the same discipline, on adjacent topics.
pdf_url may be left empty if landing_url is an EPrints-style page; the
first PDF link on it is used. expected_pages is optional; when set, the
run aborts if the fetched document is a different length, because that
means the repository served a different deposit.
